description: This Java class 'VersionChecker' checks for recommended software and firmware versions by fetching data from a remote URL, compares them with current versions, and displays update warnings or critical issue alerts accordingly.

classes.name: VersionChecker
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for checking version recommendations, displaying update warnings, and handling critical issue alerts based on remote version data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a background thread to fetch and process version data from the server.

methods.name: readAndProcess
methods.description: Fetches version data from a URL, parses it, and displays warnings or critical issue dialogs.

methods.name: parseNotNull
methods.description: Parses a string into an integer, throwing an exception if null.

methods.name: showUpdateWarningIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays an update warning dialog if the current version is outdated and not suppressed.

methods.name: getPaneParent
methods.description: Returns the main JFrame component for dialog positioning.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of VersionChecker.

methods.name: onFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Processes firmware version string, compares with suggested version, and shows warnings if needed.
